name: mayan
author: Solvable95
description: Fly near the first set of rotating spikes at 42% (this will make the secret way not rng) and then time a hold after your icon touches the invisible mini portal at 42.3% to go to the ceiling between the rotating spikes. Fall to the floor a bit before the ball portal at 44% and stay there. Fly above the creature with the spikes on the floor at 66% and then move back to the floor. Stay on the floor until the end from there.
